title: Secrets Manager and Parameter Store config
prompt: How do you load AWS-managed configuration into Spring Boot safely?
answer: Use spring.config.import with the aws-parameterstore or aws-secretsmanager prefix, scope IAM to the exact paths, and treat refresh as an explicit decision.
